card.name: Digits and punctuation in policy citations
card.fires_on: Digits, spaces and punctuation inside report numbers, statute section numbers and phone numbers in government or policy web text. Also a few linking words in policy prose.

modes.label: Citation numbers
modes.description: Digits or separators inside report codes, act names or section numbers.

modes.label: Phone numbers
modes.description: Digits or brackets inside a phone number given as a contact.

modes.label: Policy prose
modes.description: A linking word or space in sentences about health insurance or government rules.
modes.example: improve the portability and continuity of health<< insurance>> coverage

card.plain: It fires on the numbers and punctuation inside legal citations, report codes and phone numbers in government text.
